newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 5.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday the U.S. Dow Jones Industrial Average slid nearly one percent to 6,852.72 on jitters ahead of Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's congressional testimony.
* In Kuala Lumpur, the benchmark Composite Index lost 13 points to close at 1,247.23 on uncertainty surrounding stocks controlled by the late head of Proton, Yahaya Ahmad.
* Stocks of the DRB-Hicom group remain suspended following the death of Yahaya on Monday night.

* Hong Leong Properties posted a 92 percent increase in net profit to for the six months to December 31, 1996. The figure stood at 81.35 million ringgit compared to 42.44 million ringgit in the same period in 1995.
